name: After § 8
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of Russian strikes in the EU, particularly on Black Sea shipping, threatening human life, regional stability and food security
part_text: 8a. Calls on the Commission and the Member States to support the protection of seafarers’ rights, including the right to refuse to sail into war zones without losing their jobs, adequate compensation for victims and their families, and full respect for the Maritime Labour Convention; calls for close cooperation with the International Transport Workers’ Federation and the IMO;
